Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.asymmetricEq.type:
∀ (v : ↑unitInterval),
  (fun u =>
      deriv (Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.asymmetricEquality.cdfSection v) ↑u) =ᵐ[MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume]
    fun u => (if ↑u < ↑v / 2 then 1 else 0) + ↑v * if ↑v / 2 < ↑u ∧ ↑u < (↑v + 1) / 2 then 1 else 0

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.conditional_.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (v : ↑unitInterval),
  0 < ↑v ∧ ↑v < 1 →
    ↑v * Verification.conditionalBinLow C v ^ 2 + (1 - ↑v) * Verification.conditionalBinHigh C v ^ 2 ≤
      ∫ (u : ↑unitInterval), C.conditionalCDF u v ^ 2

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (v : ↑unitInterval),
  0 < ↑v ∧ ↑v < 1 →
    (∫ (u : ↑unitInterval), C.conditionalCDF u v ^ 2 =
        ↑v * Verification.conditionalBinLow C v ^ 2 + (1 - ↑v) * Verification.conditionalBinHigh C v ^ 2 ↔
      ∀ᵐ (u : ↑unitInterval),
        C.conditionalCDF u v =
          if u ≤ v then Verification.conditionalBinLow C v else Verification.conditionalBinHigh C v)

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.exact_lowerS.type:
∀ (x y : ℝ),
  (∃ C, Verification.IsLowerSemilinear C ∧ C.chatterjeeXi = x ∧ C.spearmanFootrule = y) ↔
    x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 ∧ y ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 ∧ x ≤ y ∧ y ≤ √x

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.exact_nonneg.type: ∀ (x y : ℝ), 0 ≤ y → ((x, y) ∈ Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.attainableRegion ↔ y ≤ 1 ∧ y ^ 2 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1)

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.exact_si_xi_.type:
∀ (x y : ℝ),
  (∃ C, C.IsSI ∧ C.chatterjeeXi = x ∧ C.spearmanFootrule = y) ↔ x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 ∧ y ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 ∧ x ≤ y ∧ y ≤ √x

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.fixed_footru.type:
∀ (C D : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  C.spearmanFootrule = D.spearmanFootrule →
    ∀ (x : ℝ),
      C.chatterjeeXi ≤ x → x ≤ D.chatterjeeXi → ∃ E, E.chatterjeeXi = x ∧ E.spearmanFootrule = C.spearmanFootrule

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2) (x : ℝ),
  C.chatterjeeXi ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → ∃ D, D.chatterjeeXi = x ∧ D.spearmanFootrule = C.spearmanFootrule

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.footrule_cub.type:
∀ (y μ : ℝ),
  μ ∈ Set.Icc 0 2 → (Verification.relaxedFootrule μ = y ↔ μ ^ 3 - (4 + 2 * y) * μ ^ 2 - (4 + 8 * y) * μ - 8 * y = 0)

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.footrule_inv.type: ∀ y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 2) 0, ∃! μ, μ ∈ Set.Icc 0 2 ∧ Verification.relaxedFootrule μ = y

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.footrule_sub.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  C.spearmanFootrule - C.chatterjeeXi = 1 / 4 ↔
    C = Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.upperBoundary ProbabilityTheory.Copula.unitHalf

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.frechet_coef.type:
∀ (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b ≤ 1),
  (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.frechet a b ha hb hab).chatterjeeXi = (a - b) ^ 2 + a * b ∧
    (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.frechet a b ha hb hab).spearmanFootrule = a - b / 2

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.frechet_obje.type:
∀ (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b ≤ 1),
  (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.frechet a b ha hb hab).chatterjeeXi +
        (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.frechet a b ha hb hab).spearmanFootrule =
      -(1 / 16) ↔
    a = 0 ∧ b = 1 / 4

∀ (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a + b ≤ 1),
  -(1 / 16) ≤
    (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.frechet a b ha hb hab).chatterjeeXi +
      (ProbabilityTheory.Copula.frechet a b ha hb hab).spearmanFootrule

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.jensen_profi.type:
∀ μ ∈ Set.Icc 0 2,
  ∀ (v : ↑unitInterval),
    Verification.jensenLow μ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 ∧
      Verification.jensenHigh μ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 ∧
        ↑v * Verification.jensenLow μ v + (1 - ↑v) * Verification.jensenHigh μ v = ↑v

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.lowerSemilin.type:
∀ (x y : ℝ),
  (∃ C, Verification.IsLowerSemilinear C ∧ C.chatterjeeXi = x ∧ C.spearmanFootrule = y) ↔
    ∃ C, C.IsSI ∧ C.chatterjeeXi = x ∧ C.spearmanFootrule = y

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.maximal_foot.type:
∀ (x : ↑unitInterval),
  (Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.upperBoundary (Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.boundaryParameter x)).chatterjeeXi = ↑x ∧
    (Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.upperBoundary (Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.boundaryParameter x)).spearmanFootrule =
        √↑x ∧
      ∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
        C.chatterjeeXi = ↑x →
          C.spearmanFootrule ≤ √↑x ∧
            (C.spearmanFootrule = √↑x ↔
              C = Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.upperBoundary (Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.boundaryParameter x))

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.negative_foo.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  C.spearmanFootrule ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 2) 0 →
    ∃! μ,
      μ ∈ Set.Icc 0 2 ∧
        Verification.footruleCubic C.spearmanFootrule μ = 0 ∧
          Verification.xiClosed (Verification.relaxedParameter μ) ≤ C.chatterjeeXi

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.relaxed_coef.type:
∀ μ ∈ Set.Icc 0 2,
  have r := 2 / (2 + μ);
  Verification.relaxedFootrule μ = -2 * r ^ 2 + 6 * r - 5 + 1 / r ∧
    Verification.relaxedXi μ = -4 * r ^ 2 + 20 * r - 17 + 2 / r - 1 / r ^ 2 - 12 * Real.log r

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.relaxed_valu.type:
∀ (μ : ℝ),
  Verification.relaxedFootrule μ = (6 * ∫ (v : ↑unitInterval), Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.relaxedCDF μ v v) - 2 ∧
    Verification.relaxedXi μ =
      (6 * ∫ (v : ↑unitInterval) (u : ↑unitInterval), Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.relaxedKernel μ u v ^ 2) - 2

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.scalar_optim.type:
∀ μ ∈ Set.Icc 0 2,
  ∀ (v : ↑unitInterval) (a b : ℝ),
    a ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 →
      b ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 →
        ↑v * a + (1 - ↑v) * b = ↑v →
          Verification.splitObjective μ (↑v) (Verification.jensenLow μ v) (Verification.jensenHigh μ v) ≤
            Verification.splitObjective μ (↑v) a b

∀ μ ∈ Set.Icc 0 2,
  ∀ (v : ↑unitInterval),
    0 < ↑v ∧ ↑v < 1 →
      ∀ (a b : ℝ),
        a ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 →
          b ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 →
            ↑v * a + (1 - ↑v) * b = ↑v →
              (Verification.splitObjective μ (↑v) a b =
                  Verification.splitObjective μ (↑v) (Verification.jensenLow μ v) (Verification.jensenHigh μ v) ↔
                a = Verification.jensenLow μ v ∧ b = Verification.jensenHigh μ v)

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.si_equality_.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  C.IsSI →
    C.chatterjeeXi = C.spearmanFootrule →
      Monotone (Verification.conditionalOneCut C) ∧
        Monotone (Verification.conditionalPositiveCut C) ∧
          Measurable (Verification.conditionalOneCut C) ∧
            Measurable (Verification.conditionalPositiveCut C) ∧
              Measurable (Verification.conditionalMiddle C) ∧
                (∀ (v : ↑unitInterval),
                    Verification.conditionalOneCut C v ≤ v ∧ v ≤ Verification.conditionalPositiveCut C v) ∧
                  ∀ᵐ (v : ↑unitInterval) (u : ↑unitInterval),
                    C.conditionalCDF u v =
                      Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.siEqualityProfile (Verification.conditionalOneCut C v)
                        (Verification.conditionalPositiveCut C v) (Verification.conditionalMiddle C v) u

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  C.IsSI →
    (C.chatterjeeXi = C.spearmanFootrule ↔
      ∃ A B a,
        Monotone A ∧
          Monotone B ∧
            Measurable A ∧
              Measurable B ∧
                Measurable a ∧
                  ∀ᵐ (v : ↑unitInterval) (u : ↑unitInterval),
                    C.conditionalCDF u v = Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.siEqualityProfile (A v) (B v) (a v) u)

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  C.IsSI →
    (C.chatterjeeXi = C.spearmanFootrule ↔
      ∃ A B a,
        Monotone A ∧
          Monotone B ∧
            Measurable A ∧
              Measurable B ∧
                Measurable a ∧
                  ∀ᵐ (v : ↑unitInterval) (u : ↑unitInterval),
                    deriv (C.cdfSection v) ↑u = Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.siEqualityProfile (A v) (B v) (a v) u)

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.twoParameter.type:
∀ (α β : ℝ) (hα : α ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2)) (hβ : β ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2)),
  have B := Verification.diagonalHoleBand α β hα hβ;
  (Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.twoParameter α β hα hβ).toMeasure =
    MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume.withDensity fun x =>
      ENNReal.ofReal
        (if
            B.lower (x 0) ≤ ↑(ProbabilityTheory.unitQuantile B.marginal (x 1)) ∧
              ↑(ProbabilityTheory.unitQuantile B.marginal (x 1)) ≤ B.lower (x 0) + β then
          0
        else 1 / ((1 - β) * B.columnDensity (ProbabilityTheory.unitQuantile B.marginal (x 1))))

Filter.Tendsto (fun μ => (Verification.diagonalHoleAlpha μ, Verification.diagonalHoleBeta μ)) Filter.atTop
  (nhds (1 / 2, 1 / 2))

∀ (μ : ℝ),
  0 ≤ μ → Verification.diagonalHoleAlpha μ ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2) ∧ Verification.diagonalHoleBeta μ ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2)

∀ (α β : ℝ) (hα : α ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2)) (hβ : β ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2)),
  have B := Verification.diagonalHoleBand α β hα hβ;
  MeasureTheory.Measure.map Prod.fst B.measure = MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume ∧
    MeasureTheory.Measure.map Prod.snd B.measure =
      MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume.withDensity fun t => ENNReal.ofReal (B.columnDensity t)

∀ (α : ℝ) (hα : α ∈ Set.Icc 0 (1 / 2)),
  Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.twoParameter α 0 hα ⋯ = ProbabilityTheory.Copula.independence 2

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.weighted_low.type:
∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  ∀ μ ∈ Set.Icc 0 2,
    μ * Verification.relaxedFootrule μ + Verification.relaxedXi μ ≤ μ * C.spearmanFootrule + C.chatterjeeXi

∀ (C : ProbabilityTheory.Copula 2),
  ∀ μ ∈ Set.Icc 0 2,
    μ * Verification.footruleClosed (Verification.relaxedParameter μ) +
        Verification.xiClosed (Verification.relaxedParameter μ) ≤
      μ * C.spearmanFootrule + C.chatterjeeXi

Papers.Rockel2026XiFootrule.xi_one_slice.type: ∀ (y : ℝ), (∃ C, C.chatterjeeXi = 1 ∧ C.spearmanFootrule = y) ↔ y ∈ Set.Icc (-1 / 2) 1
